contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ SEVERVS AVG PART MAX ; R/ RESTITVTOR VRBIS

Silver Coin. Denarius of Septimius Severus (193-211), issue of 200-201, RIC volume 4 part 1 no. 168a,. Obverse description: Bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: SEVERVS AVG PART MAX. Reverse description: Emperor standing left in military garb, cloak over left shoulder, with patera held over tripod in right hand and with downward pointing spear in left hand. Reverse inscription: RESTITVTOR VRBIS. Diameter: 19.2mm, Weight: 3.03gms, die axis: 6
